title: Ayodhya Temple Theft Allegations Spark Controversy
summary: The alleged theft of money from the Ram temple in Ayodhya has sparked controversy, with various groups and individuals expressing their opinions on the matter. The incident has raised questions about the security and management of the temple, as well as the actions of those involved. The government has been urged to take action against those responsible for the theft.
summary_points: The alleged theft of money from the Ram temple in Ayodhya has sparked controversy.

The allegations have also drawn attention to the role of Hindu nationalist groups in the controversy.
